authorization: Owner requests finding clean persistent reversals then feature-model scoring; explicitly defines clean as sustained reverse progress with small drawdowns. Research-only tabular fitting authorized; no YOLO training, promote or execution changes.
candidate_universe: All2098alt plus158BTC causal first1-5 wick glyphs,not only retrospective601+43gallery. Same frozen currenttop20 universe; historical selection bias remains.
decision_clock: Signal15m close; OHLC features use signal bar and preceding96bars only. Completed NY Monday levels only. No eventual episode length, reentry confirmation, later price, sample membership or symbol identifier is a feature.
horizon_reason: Match the29post-signal candles visible in the existing60bar review charts;7h15m after signal close.
scale: Signal-time14bar arithmetic mean true range,not either disputed Wilder ATR implementation;closed bars only.
label: q_t=direction*(future_close_t-signal_close)/TRmean14,q_0=0. P=max(q_29,0),E=P/sum(abs(diff(q))),D=max(cummax(q)-q),A=max adverse future wick relative to signal close / TRmean14. quality=100*(P/(1+P))*E/(1+D+A). Flat/nonpositive terminal progress gets0. Close-path cleanliness plus wick adverse penalty;no intrabar trade-order assumption. Multiply by the fraction of4consecutive chronological blocks with positive net directional progress;this distinguishes a single jump then flat from sustained movement.
candidate_cutoff: Fixed80th percentile of quality among initial training events whose entire NYweek ends before2023-01-01UTC; candidate must have positive quality. This is an automatic review candidate,not owner-confirmed gold.
model: LightGBM regression on continuous quality; reuse existing fixed small-tree configuration without parameter search. All outcomes,including failures and ambiguous positive paths,remain in training.
split: Expanding quarterly tests2023Q1..2026Q4; global NYweeks and every same-episode sibling stay together. Training week expiry and label end must precede fold start. No random train/test split. All history is previously inspected exploratory research.
weights: Each globalNYweek has equal total weight; within each week each symbol has equal weight,within each symbol each episode has equal weight,and siblings share episode weight.
score: 0-100 percentile of predicted quality relative to that fold model's training predictions;not calibrated probability or winrate. Pre2023 samples have no walkforward score. Latest research model is also saved without production use.
controls: Same-fold single rejection-wick feature model and training-label shuffle within calendarquarter and side. Primary topdecile ranking diagnostic compared with conditional random candidate selections within symbol x testfold x training-defined TRpercentile bucket. Not random-time trade PnL.
statistics: Top10percent within each OOSfold is retrospective ranking diagnostic;not trade threshold. NYweek cluster bootstrap2000;conditional permutation2000;primary full model only. Report all arms,years,sides,gallery subset and full causal universe. No tuning after test results.
economics: No entry/TP/SL/fills/portfolio,so gross/net PnL,fees and trade winrate not applicable. Score is shape classification research,not a profitable strategy claim.
label_refinement: Before any model fit or metric inspection,added a one-jump-versus-steady-path behavioral test and sustained-block component;original untrained outcome labels preserved in attempts/before_sustained_component.
